name: morning competitor summary
trigger: the clock reaches seven in the morning on a working day

carries.name: blogs
carries.what: the addresses of the three competitor blogs to read

carries.name: team
carries.what: who the approved summary goes to

concurrency: one run a day; a run still open when the next morning comes is closed as abandoned before the next starts
goal: a one-page summary of what the three competitor blogs published since the last run, each point with its source, approved by the person who asked and sent to the team

phases.name: read-the-blogs
phases.does: every post the three blogs published since the last run, each with its address and date

phases.name: write-the-summary
phases.does: a one-page summary of the posts, each point with its source

phases.name: approve-the-summary
phases.does: the person who asked reads the summary and approves it, asks for changes, or rejects it

phases.name: send-to-the-team
phases.does: the approved summary sent to the team
phases.reaches_outside: sends the summary to the team by email

handoffs.what: every post read, with its address and date
the one-page summary, each point with its source
the summary as approved, with who approved it and when
the summary as sent, with the time it went

deviations.what: the person names what is wrong, and the summary is written again from the same posts

data: the three blogs' addresses as handed
policy: nothing goes to the team before the person who asked approves it
every point in the summary names its source

measures.cycle time: from seven in the morning to the summary in the team's inboxes
measures.quality gate: every summary sent was approved first, and every point in it names its source

questions.question: Which three blogs? Give their addresses.
